$comment: Every publication PR carries exactly one publication-manifest.json at the PR head root. It is the filing's cover sheet: what is being filed, under what authority, and who authorized the exact bytes. The validator checks every field mechanically; Clinton's PR review checks the substance.

authority_refs.description: Every Order/Judgment/Rule citation the filing relies on. The validator unions these with citations extracted from the filing text itself; every one must resolve to an existing record.

authorization_receipt.description: Recorded authorization. The content_sha256 MUST equal the sha256 of the primary file's exact bytes; any byte difference voids the authorization.

classification.description: 'public' only. This validator blocks 'private' unconditionally; private records belong on the private canonical docket.

files.description: Every file this PR files. The primary file gets full filing-type validation; all files get the privacy scan and duplicate-blob check. Every listed path MUST appear in the PR's changed-files set.

matter_linkage.description: Optional matter/proceeding linkage. Per HC2 (2026-10-12): Orders are NOT Matters; an unlinked Order is NOT a defect; no linkage is ever invented. Standing orders must NOT carry a matter number.

notes.description: Free-text notes for the Human reviewer. Never trusted by the validator.

privacy_waivers.description: Waivers apply to PRIVACY-SCAN findings ONLY, and only when approved_by is exactly 'Clinton Brown' with a non-empty justification. Waived findings are still reported in the verdict, never hidden. There is no waiver for missing authorization, unresolvable authority, or duplicates.

match.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against the flagged text.

record_id.description: Stable record identifier, e.g. O-PRIVACY-PRE-PUBLICATION-DUTY, J-0021, PUB-M-012, R-2026-10-12-001.

record_type.description: One of the types defined in filing-types.json.

supersedes.description: REQUIRED for record_type 'correction': the id of the superseded record. The superseded file must NOT be among the PR's changed files (no in-place edits, Art. VIII section 5).

title: Atlas publication manifest
